description: Schur–Weyl duality DERIVES the C(4,n) flavor factor of the n-body binding weight as dim ∧^n(C^4)=V_{[1^n]}^{GL_4}, upgrading #3676's Wigner hypothesis to a theorem for the flavor leg. Truncation at n=4 is Pauli (antisymmetric-specific). w_n = C(4,n)·w_n^spatial; spatial leg open (z2bn). Nothing wired.

result.verdict: SCHUR–WEYL DERIVES THE FLAVOR FACTOR (upgrades #3676's Wigner hypothesis; no fit, nothing wired): by Schur–Weyl duality on (C^4)^{⊗n}, the fully-antisymmetric n-body flavor channel is ∧^n(C^4)=V_{[1^n]}^{GL_4} with dim = C(4,n) EXACTLY (Weyl dim formula = exterior power). So the C(4,n) that #3676 introduced as the Wigner-supermultiplet hypothesis is a DERIVED Schur–Weyl fact for the flavor leg, and its n>4 vanishing is Pauli exclusion on 4 flavors — specific to the antisymmetric channel (symmetric [n] stays nonzero). The weight factorizes w_n = C(4,n)_flavor · w_n^spatial: the flavor leg is now derived; the spatial (Specht/Hecke) leg is the separately-OPEN piece the active z2bn/lever1 'classical binding kernel' line is working. SCOPE GUARD: derives the FLAVOR factor only — NOT the spatial factor (z2bn open), NOT the per-order M_n(K) (qou-v0yw open); wires NOTHING, B stays open. NO tier change.
